title: Edit a text file using the nano editor
summary: Nano is a simple, beginner-friendly text editor that runs in the terminal. You can open a file, make changes, and save them easily.

steps.explain: Open the specified file in the nano editor. If the file does not exist, nano will create it when you save.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the file you want to edit.

steps.explain: To exit nano, press Ctrl+X. If you made changes, nano will ask if you want to save them.
